methodology.retryPolicy: Every non-verified first attempt was retried exactly once; the second attempt is final.
methodology.frameSelection: iframe[name=result], falling back to a frame whose URL contains fiddle.jshell.net
methodology.meaningfulContent: Non-empty visible body text, a visible canvas/svg/img/video/audio, or another visible non-script body descendant with non-zero dimensions.

classifications.verified: Result frame loaded, meaningful rendered content exists, and no uncaught page error occurred.
classifications.rendered-with-errors: Meaningful rendered content exists, but one or more uncaught page errors occurred.
classifications.empty: Result frame loaded, but meaningful rendered content did not exist after the settle interval.
classifications.blocked: An HTTP status or challenge/access marker prevented loading the result frame.
classifications.timeout: Navigation or result-frame inspection exceeded its bounded timeout.
classifications.failed: Another navigation, frame, or runtime inspection failure prevented classification above.

methodology.cloudflareFailureExclusion: Failed requests matching cloudflareinsights.com, /cdn-cgi/rum, /cdn-cgi/trace, or beacon.min.js are retained in ignoredFailedRequests and excluded from failedRuntimeRequestCount.
